scope: This complete collection includes all 48 converged matched continuous-prior fits, all 672 prescribed conditional cases, the interrupted incomplete v1 with four nonconverged fits, all numerical-only probes, the 40,000-dataset phase control, all 12 registered dictionary replays, and all 96 breakdown cases. Collection completeness is not success of every scientific/numerical attempt. The v1 incomplete flags and all unfavorable outcomes remain unchanged. Original experimental inputs are obtained from the public data URLs and prior release dependencies.
